source_text: Aperit Dominus os asinae et oculos Balaam. Correctio divina et confessio: peccavi ignorans.
pass_a_gloss: Opens Lord mouth of-donkey and eyes of-Balaam. Correction divine and confession: I-sinned not-knowing.
pass_b_english: [[The Lord opens the donkey’s mouth and Balaam’s eyes >> Bible:Numbers 22:28-31]]. Divine correction meets confession: I have sinned unknowingly.
